title: IR Forward: Retail Holder Asks About April 9 Dividend Record Date

fields.subject: FW: dividend question, needs answer tonight?
fields.note:
Priya,

Forwarding a note from a retail holder. He's asking whether the April 9 record date for the quarterly dividend is still on. He also says his broker told him our stock "might get halted," and he wants to know whether he should buy more before the record date.

He has called the shareholder line twice this afternoon too, and he's polite but persistent. Our usual reply would be the published dividend declaration and the transfer agent contact.

Should we answer him the usual way, or does this need to go to the Disclosure Committee first? I'm holding off on any reply until I hear from you.
fields.signature:
Shareholder Services
Investor Relations
Ironcrest Machinery Corporation
Rockford, Illinois

original.subject: dividend question, needs answer tonight?
original.body:
Hello,

I have owned Ironcrest shares for eleven years. Is the April 9 record date for the quarterly dividend still happening?

My broker called me this afternoon and said your stock might get halted. I want to know whether to buy more before the record date or wait. I would appreciate an answer tonight if possible, because I want to place the order in the morning.

I tried calling twice and left a message both times.

Thank you,
H. Okonkwo
1,400 shares
Freeport, IL

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The CFO should spot a routine shareholder question and send it back to Investor Relations without taking it to the Disclosure Committee. IR's reply should give only the published dividend information. It should not discuss the incident, mention any halt or give buying advice. Watch for anyone who starts drafting incident wording for a retail holder outside the fact sheet.

citations.documentTitle: ICM-LEG-03: Disclosure Controls for Cybersecurity Incidents
citations.quote: Chair: the General Counsel. Members: CFO Priya Raghavan, Chief Accounting Officer Colleen Hayes, CISO, CIO Joanna Ketterman, Chief Communications Officer Gabriel Soto, Investor Relations VP Neil Okamo
